svg.title: Kernel addressing
svg.text: Inside one program: from token positions to physical slots
toy: block size B = 4, ctx_len = 10, BLOCK_N = 8, block table = [7, 2, 5]
Colour = logical block. Masked lanes (grey) load phys 0 via other=0 and their scores become −∞, so they never count.
Real cache [N, 16, 8, 64]: element address = phys·8192 + offset·512 + kv_head·64 + d (the strides).
